ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of visible surface; localized high-intensity (white/tan) pixels provide high local contrast at margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark contiguous region punctuated by high-contrast, irregular circular blobs (barnacles/scars) concentrated at distal tips and scattered medially.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated angle of 65-75 degrees and deep penetration relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; peaks are prominent and distinct against the water background with varying amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curves for both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of tan and white pixel blobs localized at the distal tips of both lobes; several isolated white circular spots (~2-5 pixel radius) scattered across the medial black field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles on the outer tips of both fluke lobes, creating distinct textured protrusions and high-contrast color mapping (white/tan) against the black fluke body.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy colonization of barnacles specifically localized at the distal fluke tips, forming a unique morphological profile.
